text: In medieval Europe, water-powered mills did more than grind grain: millwrights adapted cams to drive hammers, automating work such as fulling cloth.
A neighbourhood tool library turns occasional-use drills and ladders into shared resources; borrowing locally can make repairs easier without every household buying its own kit.
Spend two minutes checking a mug’s handle for a hairline crack; if it’s sound, wipe away tea stains with a damp cloth and return it ready to use.
